WonderBites Portals API

Reference for the Admin and Merchant portals of the WonderBites surplus-food marketplace. 330 operations across 256 paths, 281 schemas and 83 enums. Base URL /api/v1. Machine-readable source: openapi.yaml (delivered as a separate file) (OpenAPI 3.1) · builder summary and v1.1 change log: API_CONTRACT.md (in the source package). v1.1 has been reconciled with the final screen code and mock adapters.

Conventions

  • Base URL /api/v1. Path families: /auth/*, /shared/* (notifications, search, exports, uploads, imports, language, impact, meta, help), /admin/*, /merchant/*, /stream. JSON bodies, camelCase keys. Accept-Language: en|ar localizes labels/messages; editable content fields are LocalizedText = { en, ar }.
  • Auth: Authorization: Bearer <access JWT> (15 min) + rotating refresh token (30 days) via POST /auth/refresh. 2FA via POST /auth/otp/verify.
  • Roles: super_admin, operations_admin, support_agent, read_only (admin portal); merchant_owner, merchant_staff (merchant portal). Each operation lists allowed roles in x-roles. Merchant tokens are scoped to their merchantId; staff may be limited to branchIds.
  • Lists: { data: [...], page, pageSize, total, summary? }. summary carries the KPI tiles / tab counts of the same screen for the same filters.
  • Query: q, status, category, city, dietary, sort, page, pageSize, from, to (+ screen-specific filters). from/to = global date-range picker (ISO-8601 UTC). branchId scopes merchant endpoints (omit / all = every branch). pageSize default 10 (max 100). sort=field asc, sort=-field desc. dietary is comma-separated.
  • Money: { amount: number, currency: "QAR" | "AED" | "SAR" } (major units, 2 dp). Every amount carries its own currency — never assume one.
  • Markets (v1.3): the platform runs in markets (GET /shared/markets: currency, currency label, phone code, time zone, cities, VAT, enabled). Qatar (QA, QAR, +974, Asia/Qatar) is the launch market; UAE (AE) and KSA (SA) ship disabled and are enabled from Admin → Settings → Markets (PATCH /admin/settings/markets/{code}) — no code changes. Merchants, branches and users carry country; branches also currency + timeZone.
  • market query param: every admin read accepts market=all|QA|AE|SA (default all = every enabled market). Lists return rows of those markets only, each row in its own currency. KPI/chart aggregates are returned in the market's currency, or — when all spans several currencies — converted to the reporting currency (GET/PUT /admin/settings/fx, default QAR) with meta.market.converted = true. Merchant reads are scoped by branchId; aggregates come back in that branch's currency.
  • Time: timestamps ISO-8601 UTC (2026-11-19T16:30:00Z; the demo data is anchored on 2026-11-19); dates YYYY-MM-DD; pickup windows { start: "HH:mm", end: "HH:mm" } and operating hours in the branch's local time zone (branch.timeZone); clients render UTC timestamps in the branch / market time zone.
  • KPIs / charts: Kpi { key, label, value, format, currency?, delta?, deltaUnit, trend, comparison?, caption?, sparkline? }; Series { key, label, kind, points: [{ x, y }] }; Segment { key, label, value, share }.
  • Errors: { error: { code, message, details } } — validation_error 400/422, unauthorized 401, forbidden 403, not_found 404, conflict 409, policy_violation 422, rate_limited 429, internal 500.
  • Orders (v1.4): one state machine for both portals — each order carries allowedActions and active (paid, not yet collected); any other action returns 409 invalid_transition. Self-pickup orders complete only by verifying the 6-character pickup code (POST /merchant/pickups/verify or Admin → Pickups), which is single-use and expires at the window end + 30 min. Commission comes from GET /admin/settings/commercial (19 % default) or a merchant contract.
  • Exports are async jobs (POST /shared/exports → poll or wait for export.ready). Uploads use presigned URLs (POST /shared/uploads/presign → PUT bytes → pass fileId).
  • Realtime: WebSocket wss://…/api/v1/stream (or SSE) delivering { id, type, occurredAt, data }; event payloads are documented under webhooks.
  • Idempotency: send Idempotency-Key on money-moving POSTs (refunds, credits, payouts).

Auth & roles

Login → (optional OTP) → accessToken (JWT, 15 min) + refreshToken (30 days, rotating, single use). Send Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>. On 401 unauthorized call POST /auth/refresh once, then retry; if that fails, route to login. Merchant tokens carry merchantId and optional branchIds.

RolePortalScope
super_adminadminEverything incl. users & access, settings, policy overrides, deletes
operations_adminadminDrops, pickups, orders, merchants, consumers, compliance, wallet/vouchers, templates, CMS, payouts
support_agentadminSupport tickets, cases & moderation, refunds/cancels within policy, issue credit, block consumers; read elsewhere
read_onlyadminAll GET endpoints (dashboards & reports); no writes; pickup codes masked
merchant_ownermerchantAll merchant endpoints for own merchant (branches, vendors, drivers, store & security settings)
merchant_staffmerchantDay-to-day: orders, listings/inventory, products, templates, customers, reviews, disputes, help — limited to assigned branches

Errors

{ "error": { "code": "validation_error", "message": "Some fields are invalid", "details": { "price.amount": "Must be lower than originalPrice" } } }
HTTPcodeWhen
400validation_errorMalformed query/body
401unauthorizedMissing/expired token, bad credentials
403forbiddenRole not allowed / other merchant's data
404not_foundUnknown id
409conflictState conflict (already verified, code exists, active reservations)
409invalid_transitionOrder state machine: action not allowed from the current status (details.from/to/allowed); terminal: completed, cancelled, refunded
409code_used / moderation_hold / sold_outPickup code already used · listing disabled by WonderBites · not enough bags
422invalid_code / code_expiredPickup code doesn’t match the order · expired (window end + 30 min)
403pending_verification / account_rejected / account_suspendedMerchant sign-in blocked until approval / after rejection or suspension
422validation_error / policy_violationField errors in details; refund outside policy
429rate_limitedToo many requests (Retry-After header)
500internalUnexpected — retry with backoff

Shared & Auth

Auth (login · sign-up · forgot/reset · OTP) admin-login / m-login / m-signup / forgot / reset / otp

POST/api/v1/auth/loginSign in (admin or merchant portal)

If the account has 2FA, returns requires2fa: true + challengeId and no tokens; continue with /auth/otp/verify. 401 unauthorized on bad credentials; 403 forbidden if the role does not belong to the requested portal; 423-like lock is returned as 429 rate_limited after 5 attempts. Merchant accounts: 403 pending_verification (sign-up awaiting admin approval), account_rejected, account_suspended.

Roles: public · operationId postAuthLogin
Request body: LoginRequest  ·  Response 200: LoginResponse

{

  "password": "••••••••",
  "portal": "admin",
  "remember": true
}

POST/api/v1/auth/otp/verifyVerify OTP / 2FA code

For a merchant sign-up challenge the code only verifies the email: returns { verified: true, status: pending_verification, merchantId } and no tokens — the merchant signs in after Admin → Merchants approves it.

Roles: public · operationId postAuthOtpResend
Request body: { challengeId: string }  ·  Response 200: { sentTo: string, retryAfter: integer }

GET/api/v1/admin/drops/summaryKPI tiles only (drops)

Same object as the list response summary; lets KPI tiles load independently of the table.

Roles: super_adminoperations_adminsupport_agentread_only · operationId getAdminDropsSummary
ParamInTypeDescription
qquerystringFree-text search (name, code/ID, email…)
statusqueryDropStatus
categoryqueryCategoryCategory filter
cityquerystringCity filter (id from /shared/meta/cities)
dietaryqueryDietary[]Dietary tags (comma-separated, match all)
merchantIdquerystring
fromquerydatetimeGlobal date range start (ISO-8601 UTC, inclusive)
toquerydatetimeGlobal date range end (ISO-8601 UTC, exclusive)
marketquerystring(v1.3) Market scope of every admin read: all (default) = every ENABLED market, or a market code (QA, AE, SA). Lists return only rows of those markets (each row keeps its own currency); KPI/chart aggregates are in the market's currency, or converted to the reporting currency when all spans several currencies (see meta.market).
Request body: —  ·  Response 200: DropSummary
Response 200 example
{
  "totalDrops": 10,
  "bagsAvailableNow": 14,
  "reserved": 82,
  "collected": 53,
  "flaggedForReview": 2
}

POST/api/v1/admin/pickups/{pickupId}/verifyVerify pickup passport code (modal)

Same helper as the merchant portal: verifies the code, marks it used and completes the order (one pickup_verified timeline event); response includes order. Wrong code → 200 valid:false, reason: invalid_code; 409 code_used / invalid_transition; 422 code_expired. Emits pickup.verified.

Same object as the list response summary; lets KPI tiles load independently of the table.

ParamInTypeDescription
qquerystringFree-text search (name, code/ID, email…)
statusqueryPickupStatus
categoryqueryCategoryCategory filter
cityquerystringCity filter (id from /shared/meta/cities)
dietaryqueryDietary[]Dietary tags (comma-separated, match all)
fromquerydatetimeGlobal date range start (ISO-8601 UTC, inclusive)
toquerydatetimeGlobal date range end (ISO-8601 UTC, exclusive)
marketquerystring(v1.3) Market scope of every admin read: all (default) = every ENABLED market, or a market code (QA, AE, SA). Lists return only rows of those markets (each row keeps its own currency); KPI/chart aggregates are in the market's currency, or converted to the reporting currency when all spans several currencies (see meta.market).

Same object as the list response summary; lets KPI tiles load independently of the table.

ParamInTypeDescription
qquerystringFree-text search (name, code/ID, email…)
statusqueryOrderStatus
categoryqueryCategoryCategory filter
cityquerystringCity filter (id from /shared/meta/cities)
dietaryqueryDietary[]Dietary tags (comma-separated, match all)
fromquerydatetimeGlobal date range start (ISO-8601 UTC, inclusive)
toquerydatetimeGlobal date range end (ISO-8601 UTC, exclusive)
marketquerystring(v1.3) Market scope of every admin read: all (default) = every ENABLED market, or a market code (QA, AE, SA). PATCH/api/v1/admin/settings/markets/{code}Enable / disable a market, edit time zone, phone code, VAT

Enabling takes effect immediately: the market appears in the admin market switcher, country/city filters, merchant sign-up and branch creation. 409 conflict when disabling the last enabled market or the market of the reporting currency. Also edits the market's support contacts (supportEmail, supportPhone, supportWhatsApp, supportHours) used by Need Help and merchant Help.

Listings (Bags) & Inventory (+ Add Listing, detail) m-listings / m-inventory / m-inventory-new / m-inventory-detail

GET/api/v1/merchant/listingsListings (Bags) / Inventory list

Used by both Listings (Bags) and Inventory screens. sort: -createdAt | price | -sold | title.

Roles: merchant_ownermerchant_staff · operationId getMerchantListings
ParamInTypeDescription
branchIdquerystringMerchant branch scope; omit or all = all branches
qquerystringFree-text search (name, code/ID, email…)
statusqueryListingStatus
stockStatusqueryStockStatus
categoryqueryCategoryCategory filter
cityquerystringCity filter (id from /shared/meta/cities)
dietaryqueryDietary[]Dietary tags (comma-separated, match all)
sortquerystringSort field; prefix - for descending. Default -createdAt (Newest First).
pagequeryinteger1-based page
pageSizequeryintegerItems per page (default 10)
fromquerydatetimeGlobal date range start (ISO-8601 UTC, inclusive)
toquerydatetimeGlobal date range end (ISO-8601 UTC, exclusive)

Realtime & webhooks

Connect once per session: wss://api.wonderbites.app/api/v1/stream?token=<accessToken> (WebSocket) or GET /api/v1/stream with Accept: text/event-stream (SSE, auto-reconnect with Last-Event-ID). Optional filters: events=order.status_changed,alert.created, branchId. Server sends a ping every 25 s; client may send {"type":"subscribe","events":[…]}. Admins receive platform-wide events (filtered by role); merchants receive only events for their merchant/branches. The same payloads can be delivered as signed HTTPS webhooks (X-WB-Signature: t=…,v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, t + "." + body), retries with exponential backoff for 24 h).

{ "id": "evt_9001", "type": "order.status_changed", "occurredAt": "2026-11-19T16:30:00Z", "data": { … } }
